info.title: Qubirex API
info.description: Generated from the Express routers by scripts/openapi.js. Do not edit by hand.

cookieSession.name: qbx_session
cookieSession.description: httpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie. State-changing requests also need X-CSRF-Token.

bearer.description: Same session token; accepted until the frontend moves to cookies (docs/decisions.md D-002).

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required when authenticating with the session cookie.

Error.description: Error. New routes (/api/employer, /api/verify, /api/practical) answer {error: {code, message}}; legacy routes answer {error: string}.
